crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him in the earth, a blameless and…
Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.
In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.
I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way…
because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.
Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

translations.web: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
translations.bsb: I will cling to my righteousness and never let go. As long as I live, my conscience will not accuse me.
translations.kjv: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
translations.asv: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
